hypothesis.claim: Nested component-preset fields must either retain their extension semantics or fail before a mutation reaches persistence; silent source coercion and alias precedence are unsafe.
hypothesis.trigger: source unknown/scalar fields, metadata non-finite values, or conflicting aliases/wrapper fields
hypothesis.expected_baseline: HTTP create can return 201 while dropping source fields; direct metadata NaN fails later during serialization; conflicting aliases silently win
hypothesis.expected_candidate: covered nested errors return structured client errors before save, while open metadata extensions and single aliases remain compatible
hypothesis.falsifier: any covered input is silently coerced/dropped, saves only to fail later, or changes valid extension/CRUD compatibility

implementation: strictly type nested persisted/API scalar fields
validate metadata through to_primitive before constructing/saving
reject conflicting aliases and wrapper/outer fields
reject numeric persisted IDs and null sources in strict paths
activation_checks: parent matrix reproduced source coercion, alias precedence, and late metadata failure
direct and HTTP nested errors now return structured client errors
HTTP JSON NaN remains bad_json at the trust boundary
valid CRUD, open metadata keys, and single-alias compatibility remain green
